newsAll.head: Tyson Bagent: Cleared to practice Saturday
newsAll.body: Bagent (concussion) will be back at practice Saturday after progressing through the league's concussion protocol, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

newsAll.head: Caleb Williams: Not practicing Saturday
newsAll.body: Williams (hamstring) will not participate in Saturday's practice, Jason Lieser of the Chicago Suns-Times reports.

newsAll.head: DeVonta Smith: Practicing again Saturday
newsAll.body: Smith (hamstring) is participating in Saturday's practice, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

newsAll.head: Alec Pierce: Officially goes on injured reserve
newsAll.body: Pierce (heel) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

newsAll.head: Zay Flowers: Could be limited if active
newsAll.body: Flowers (hamstring) is expected to "test his injury" prior to Sunday's game against the Cowboys, and if he suits up he "will likely be on a pitch count," Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
